rows.notes: The paper states explicitly that it is a review ('The aim of this review paper is to give some basic benefits, gains and rules of drip irrigation and fertigation'). It reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs; the water-saving figures (30-50%, 30-70%) and Table 1 are taken from other sources (Postel et al. 2001; Cetin and Bilgel 2002; Shah 2011). Statements that drip delivers water directly to the root zone and reduces evaporation and runoff are asserted from the literature, not from the authors' own results. Q1 is 'no', so Q2-Q9 are 'no'.

notes: Short narrative review article (6 pages) with figures of drip systems and a table of yield/water-saving values borrowed from Shah (2011); no primary results. Text appears complete.
